decisions.scenario: Getting contact details for a Korean restaurant in central Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like a restaurant that serves Korean food, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Little Seoul is an expensive Korean restaurant in the city centre.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: What are the address and phone number?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Little Seoul is at 108 Regent Street, City Centre, and the phone number is 01223 308681.

decisions.scenario: Getting the address of a moderately priced British restaurant in west Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like a moderately priced restaurant in the west part of town, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are two Italian restaurants and one British restaurant that match. Which would you like to know more about?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Please give me the address of the British restaurant.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Saint Johns Chop House is a British restaurant at 21-24 Northampton Street.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: What type of food do they serve?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Saint Johns Chop House serves British food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thank you for using this system. Goodbye.
